title: Submit a chargeback once — refuse the resubmit
narrative: A filed dispute is investigated, then the agent submits the chargeback; KIFF allows it once the dispute is INVESTIGATED and signs a receipt. When the agent re-submits the same dispute (a common retry that bills a second scheme penalty), KIFF refuses it — SUBMIT_CHARGEBACK is only allowed from INVESTIGATED, and the dispute is now SUBMITTED.

steps.description: An analyst investigates the dispute (state → INVESTIGATED).
The agent submits the chargeback. Allowed — the dispute is INVESTIGATED. Signed receipt.
The agent re-submits the same dispute. KIFF refuses it (state_not_allowed) — no duplicate scheme fee. Signed refusal.
